newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end day lower after erasing earlier gains.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end day lower after erasing earlier gains.

text.p: *Key September 10-year JGB futures contract ended day lower after key official of ruling LDP party was quoted as saying option of supplementary budget cannot be ruled out.
*September fell briefly to 122.54 on this before rising slightly. Strength in cash bonds provided some support.
